dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Nihon Igikai standard receipt system), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses ORCA-specific COPY libraries (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, ORCA-BLOB, CPSYSKANRI, etc.) and MONFUNC call pattern typical of JMA ORCA.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-hoshu) software — system management / test print screen (W62 window, test receipt print preview)
purpose.summary: ORCGW62 is a screen-handling subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that manages a test print screen (W62 window). It initialises the screen, reads printer configuration from system management DB tables (codes 1031, 2005), handles BLOB import of a test PostScript file, and dispatches user events (LINK, PUTG/CLICKED, entry) to appropriate processing sections.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (63 copybooks) for screen areas and DB record layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
CALL to MONFUNC with MCP-FUNC='BLOBIMPORT' for PostScript blob handling
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen dispatch
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MONFUNC DB interface
PERFORM UNTIL loop pattern for DB cursor iteration (SYSKANRI SELECT/READ/CLOSE)
File SELECT for TESTERR error file
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding, decoded here as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. Program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. Truncated at 16000 chars; PROCEDURE DIVISION logic for 200-GMNSENI, 200-ENTRY, 500-SET-SCREEN etc. not visible but structure is clear from what is shown.
